initialize_vision_tokens: build a python module to initialize vision token embeddings by inserting image patches into a token buffer with begin and end image tokens
check_mask: create a function that validates a token array contains correctly sized placeholder blocks and returns their start positions
check_special_vision_token: create a function that verifies input data contains the correct special vision tokens at expected positions
SigLiPFromPatches_call: build a python module to run the SigLIP vision encoder forward pass on patched images and return soft token embeddings
SigLiPFromPatches_patchify_images: create a function that preprocesses and patchifies raw images into flattened patch tensors for the SigLIP vision encoder
